subject.title: [F8] Session status code=2 errors not reflected in OTel error counts

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated trusted `session.ended` diagnostics/OTel contract now, including the canonical `openclaw.end_reason` vocabulary, or should this issue be limited to error-count propagation while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102019 owns the reason taxonomy?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but span names, aggregate behavior, and end-reason enum values become operator-facing telemetry contracts that automation should not invent without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add canonical session-terminal telemetry
options.body: Create a trusted session-terminal diagnostic path, map failed terminal outcomes to OTel error status/message, and define the end-reason enum once across trajectory/docs/diagnostics-otel.

options.title: Scope to OTel error counting only
options.body: Fix the error-span/counting behavior for failed sessions now and leave `openclaw.end_reason` taxonomy to the related issue.

options.title: Fold into the end-reason issue
options.body: Treat OTel error counting and end-reason values as one broader session-lifecycle telemetry project tracked by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102019.

recommendation.title: Add canonical session-terminal telemetry
recommendation.body: Create a trusted session-terminal diagnostic path, map failed terminal outcomes to OTel error status/message, and define the end-reason enum once across trajectory/docs/diagnostics-otel.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has adjacent diagnostics event and diagnostics-otel history, and the unresolved part is a telemetry contract decision rather than a mechanical runner-only patch.
